# Hammerhead Karoo Extensions SDK

Source: https://github.com/hammerheadnav/karoo-ext

Commit: `f79f103cd0e1a9808db64474796b30d822cc0b17` (library version 1.1.9).

Copyright (c) SRAM LLC. Licensed under Apache 2.0; see LICENSE and source headers.
The upstream `lib/src/main` tree is preserved unchanged. Crow supplies a smaller
build.gradle for local Android compilation; upstream publishing, documentation,
and sample-app builds are omitted. This avoids a GitHub Packages credential
requirement in cloud builds, GitHub Actions, and Codespaces.
